intuition.title: Ligand addition controls nucleation and growth
intuition.text: Oleic acid before tin injection inhibits nucleation. The authors attribute this to strong tin-oleate binding, which lowers the nucleation driving force. Introducing oleic acid after precursor mixing accelerates growth toward an equilibrium size. They report that the final size distribution was independent of the ligand-injection time in their tested series; exact times and Figure S4 remain outside this main-only scope.

intuition.title: Phase character remains qualified
intuition.text: The 175 °C and 105 °C XRD patterns are described as primarily Pnma and Cmcm, respectively. The same discussion warns that peak broadening and similar structures prevent an unambiguous assignment. Figure 1c is a Pnma reference model, not a measured atom-coordinate dataset or proof of a unique 155 °C phase.
intuition.source_locator: Main PDF p. 1–2, Figures 1–2 and phase discussion

intuition.title: Particle size is not crystallite size
intuition.text: TEM shows irregular pseudospherical particles and HRTEM shows stacking faults. The authors report that Scherrer grain sizes are typically 30–40% smaller than TEM particle diameters. Figure 3 error bars represent within-sample size distributions, not uncertainty in sample means. Neither the size-series points nor optical gaps are assigned here to an unstated recipe temperature.
intuition.source_locator: Main PDF p. 2, TEM, Scherrer comparison and Figure 3

intuition.title: Surface chemistry produces distinct outcomes
intuition.text: Dodecanethiol displaces oleate and yields a stable suspension; its use during synthesis promotes elongated and branched structures. Ethanedithiol treatment instead immobilizes/crosslinks the NCs, making them insoluble in organic and aqueous solvents. These different operations remain separate; dose, exact conditions and referenced SI images are unavailable in this main-only scope.
intuition.source_locator: Main PDF p. 3, Ligand-exchange and modified-growth discussion

intuition.title: Photo-oxidation is an interpretation
intuition.text: Formic-acid-passivated films are photoconductive but show hysteresis and photocurrent degradation. The authors use the energy alignment inferred from cyclic voltammetry to argue that photo-oxidation of surface-bound carboxylic acids likely contributes. This is a source-attributed explanation, not a measured reaction yield or proof that every current change has that origin.
intuition.source_locator: Main PDF p. 3, Figure 4 and transport interpretation

intuition.title: Optical confinement has a series-level scope
intuition.text: The source reports 4–10 nm particles and indirect gaps from 0.9 to approximately 1.3 eV, with confinement tapering near 10 nm. Weak emission and a decay faster than the 5 ns instrument response do not establish a resolved fluorescence lifetime or quantum yield. Bulk reference gaps and dielectric constants are literature comparisons rather than measured properties of each prepared sample.

general_background.title: Thermodynamics and kinetics
general_background.summary: Thermodynamics describes which states are energetically favoured, while kinetics governs how quickly a system can move between them. A change can be favourable yet proceed slowly when an activation barrier or limited transport restricts the pathway.
